description.value: The Keremeos Branch is a small public library in the southern Okanagan's Similkameen Valley, operated by the Okanagan Regional Library — a regional system of 30 branches serving over 399,000 people across 59,600 square kilometres. The branch hosts community programming including LEGO Club events and is supported by a Friends of the Library volunteer group that runs book sales and organizes community gatherings. As one of the few public facilities in the small town of Keremeos, it can serve as a community anchor point for cyclists passing through the valley.
